description: Categorize bank transactions — Categorizes up to 60 bank or card transactions: cleans merchant names (drops store numbers and card codes), assigns one of 24 fixed spending categories, flags recurring charges and possible duplicates, and totals inflow, outflow and spend per category. Pass one transaction per line as date, description, amount. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

items.description: one transaction per line or separated by ;, e.g. 2026-11-02, UBER *TRIP 8XK2, -14.20; 2026-11-03, NETFLIX.COM, -15.49

name: ai_transactions
